blocks.text: Exercises: sentences from Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR) and from the library's public-domain books.

exercises.prompt: May God bless you.
exercises.why: **благословить → благословит** — perfective verb, 3rd person singular: it has no present tense; the present-type ending gives the future.

exercises.prompt: I'm not guaranteeing them success.
exercises.why: **гарантировать → гарантирую** — present-type form, 1st person singular.

exercises.prompt: Let's draw a stone.
exercises.why: **нарисовать → нарисуем** — perfective verb, 1st person plural: it has no present tense; the present-type ending gives the future.

exercises.prompt: Let's find out who he is.
exercises.why: **выяснить → выясним** — perfective verb, 1st person plural: it has no present tense; the present-type ending gives the future.

exercises.prompt: I can't stand people who chew gum loudly.
exercises.why: **выносить → выношу** — present-type form, 1st person singular.

exercises.prompt: Let's hope the support arrives on time.
exercises.why: **прибыть → прибудет** — perfective verb, 3rd person singular: it has no present tense; the present-type ending gives the future.

exercises.prompt: You think Tom's handsome, don't you?
exercises.why: **считать → считаешь** — present-type form, 2nd person singular: ending -ешь belongs to the first (е) conjugation.

exercises.prompt: Will Iran attack Israel?
exercises.why: **напасть → нападёт** — perfective verb, 3rd person singular: it has no present tense; the present-type ending gives the future.

exercises.prompt: I'm sure Tom is going to hate me.
exercises.why: **возненавидеть → возненавидит** — perfective verb, 3rd person singular: it has no present tense; the present-type ending gives the future.

exercises.prompt: He walks the children to school.
exercises.why: **отводить → отводит** — present-type form, 3rd person singular: ending -ит belongs to the second (и) conjugation.

exercises.prompt: Take control of the command post.
exercises.why: **захватить → Захватите** — perfective verb, 2nd person plural: it has no present tense; the present-type ending gives the future.

exercises.q: В следующем году я ___ (вернуться) в Макао.
exercises.prompt: Next year I will return to Macao.
exercises.why: **вернуться → вернусь** — perfective verb, 1st person singular: it has no present tense; the present-type ending gives the future.

exercises.prompt: Let’s join hands, friends!
exercises.why: **взяться → Возьмёмся** — perfective verb, 1st person plural: it has no present tense; the present-type ending gives the future.

exercises.prompt: How will this affect us?
exercises.why: **отразиться → отразится** — perfective verb, 3rd person singular: it has no present tense; the present-type ending gives the future.

exercises.q: За его неподобающее поведение начальник ___ (задать) ему головомойку.
exercises.prompt: The boss will chew him out for his inappropriate behavior.
exercises.why: **задать → задаст** — perfective verb, 3rd person singular: it has no present tense; the present-type ending gives the future.

exercises.q: Блаженны чистые сердцем, ибо они Бога ___ (узреть).
exercises.prompt: Blessed are the pure in heart, for they shall see God.
exercises.why: **узреть → узрят** — perfective verb, 3rd person plural: it has no present tense; the present-type ending gives the future.

exercises.prompt: United we stand, divided we fall.
exercises.why: **пасть → падем** — perfective verb, 1st person plural: it has no present tense; the present-type ending gives the future.

exercises.q: В этой вьюге мы Тома никогда не ___ (найти).
exercises.prompt: We'll never find Tom in this blizzard.
exercises.why: **найти → найдём** — perfective verb, 1st person plural: it has no present tense; the present-type ending gives the future.

exercises.prompt: Let's wait out the rain here.
exercises.why: **переждать → переждём** — perfective verb, 1st person plural: it has no present tense; the present-type ending gives the future.

exercises.prompt: Tom always gets rowdy when he drinks tequila.
exercises.why: **выпить → выпьет** — perfective verb, 3rd person singular: it has no present tense; the present-type ending gives the future.
